question: Bhajan Sopori, a Padma Shri awardee, is a _________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**santoor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhajan Sopori** is a renowned **santoor** player.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri** for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• The **santoor** is a traditional Indian stringed instrument, often used in classical and folk music.
 
• Bhajan Sopori has significantly influenced the popularization and evolution of the **santoor** on both national and international stages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Shri** is one of the highest civilian awards in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields.
 
• Bhajan Sopori hails from the Sufiana Gharana of Kashmir, which has a rich tradition of santoor music.
 
• He has also been honored with several other awards, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the **Jammu and Kashmir State Award**.
 
• In addition to performing, Bhajan Sopori has been a dedicated teacher, nurturing many students in the art of santoor playing.
